text: ここに　たまに　くる　ワタルって　ひと…　いつも　マントを　かっていくの　おなじ　マントを　なんまいも　もってるのかな？

structure.jp: ここに　たまに　くる　ワタルって　ひと…
structure.en: that person called Lance who comes here now and then...

structure.jp: いつも　マントを　かっていくの
structure.en: he always buys a cape and leaves

structure.jp: おなじ　マントを　なんまいも　もってるのかな？
structure.en: I wonder if he has lots of the same cape?

patterns.name: 〜という
patterns.explanation: って between a name and a word is the casual form of という and means 'called'. ワタルって ひと = 'the person called Lance'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says someone does the action and then goes away. かっていく = 'buys one and leaves'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end of a sentence means 'I wonder', said half to oneself. もってるのかな = 'I wonder if he has them'.
